content.title: US stock rally pulls back, but Wall Street is still bullish
content.description:
US stocks (^DJI, ^GSPC, ^IXIC) reached record highs last week, but are pulling back on Monday. Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma joins Morning Brief host Julie Hyman to discuss the latest market action.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Morning Brief.
